<!-- DVL-PL-FORM:START -->
<style>
  .hs_cos_wrapper_type_form,.hs-form-private,.hbspt-form{max-width:560px!important;width:100%!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important;display:block!important;padding-top:50px!important;padding-bottom:50px!important;}
  .hs-form label{color:#012638!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:600!important;letter-spacing:.04em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;margin-bottom:6px!important;display:block!important;text-align:left!important;}
  .hs-form fieldset{max-width:100%!important;}
  .hs-form input[type="text"],.hs-form input[type="email"],.hs-form input[type="tel"],.hs-form textarea,.hs-form select{width:100%!important;background:white!important;border:1px solid #c0cdd6!important;border-radius:4px!important;padding:12px 14px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#012638!important;margin-bottom:20px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;}
  .hs-form input:focus,.hs-form textarea:focus{outline:none!important;border-color:#6BA644!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(107,166,68,.15)!important;}
  .hs-form input[type="submit"],.hs-form .hs-button{background:#012638!important;color:white!important;border:none!important;border-radius:4px!important;padding:16px 40px!important;font-size:16px!important;font-weight:bold!important;cursor:pointer!important;display:block!important;width:100%!important;margin-top:8px!important;text-decoration:none!important;}
  .hs-form input[type="submit"]:hover,.hs-form .hs-button:hover{background:#01202a!important;}
  .hs-form-private .form-title,.hbspt-form .form-title,.hs_cos_wrapper_type_form .form-title{color:#012638!important;font-size:20px!important;font-weight:bold!important;text-align:center!important;display:block!important;margin-bottom:24px!important;}
</style>
<!-- DVL-PL-FORM:END -->
<!-- DVL-PL-INGREDIENTS-GRID:START -->
<style>
  /* Force all tile grids on this page to 4 columns */
  [id*="218940115771"] .tile-grid-wrapper,
  [id*="218940115771"] ul,
  [id*="218940115771"] .grid,
  .widget-type-custom_widget ul,
  .dnd-module ul {
    display: grid !important;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 24px !important;
  }
  /* Reduce card padding so 4 fit comfortably */
  .widget-type-custom_widget li,
  .dnd-module li {
    min-width: 0 !important;
  }
</style>
<!-- DVL-PL-INGREDIENTS-GRID:END -->
<!-- QBS-SCHEMA:START -->
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","@id":"https://www.praxerasupplements.com/learning/ingredients-testing#faq","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Who is the Ingredients & Testing guide written for?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Brand builders who want to understand what 'quality' actually means in supplement manufacturing, so they can evaluate manufacturing partners (us or anyone else) intelligently. Also useful for marketing leaders who want to defensibly speak to quality on their website and labels."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does the guide get technical?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"It strikes a balance. We explain testing methods and certifications in plain language with enough technical depth that you understand what's actually being checked and why. You don't need a chemistry background to follow it."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Will I understand my Certificates of Analysis after reading this guide?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. The guide walks through what each line on a typical CoA means, what good values look like, and what red flags to watch for. Most brand builders never look at their CoAs because they don't know how to read them. After this guide, you will."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I share this guide with my retail buyers or marketing team?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Absolutely. It's specifically designed to be useful for non-manufacturing audiences. Many of our clients share it with their retail accounts as a way to demonstrate manufacturing rigor."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does this guide cover regulatory compliance?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"It touches on the regulatory framework (DSHEA, FDA testing expectations) at a high level. For deep regulatory compliance specifically, the Definitive Guide goes broader. The Ingredients & Testing guide focuses on the quality and verification side."}}]}]}</script>
